# STRAUSS Toolbox XR – Your Virtual Toolkit in Mixed Reality

The STRAUSS Toolbox XR app transforms your Meta Quest 3 / 3S into a powerful, professional measurement and planning tool. Designed for craftsmen and ambitious DIY users, the app combines essential functions for efficient work – intuitive, fast, and without the need for additional equipment.

Measure distances and angles in real time, use an integrated level, or transfer shapes directly from your surroundings. Create and calculate areas, including reference values per square meter, and take notes directly in your space – your digital toolkit, ideal for planning and cost estimation.

All captured data can be easily shared as a CSV file and exported via cable or conveniently through WhatsApp.

Whether on the construction site, in the workshop, or at home: STRAUSS Toolbox XR brings efficiency and digital support exactly where you work.
